title: Ghost Hand
synopsis: This is Part 1 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.

fullText.simplified:
这是一个十二月的夜晚，时间已经过了十二点。
    说话声和笑声时不时地从一个三层楼的小洋楼里传来。有四个人坐在小洋楼客厅的沙发上。虽然已经很晚了，但是他们完全没有睡意，因为他们正在兴奋地讲着鬼故事。
    这四个人中，有两人是这个屋子的主人和主妇。主人李时，年龄大概三十岁，是一个公子哥儿，因为家里有钱，他每天只知道吃喝玩乐。主妇文华，不过二十四五岁，穿着漂亮的衣服，笑起来很美。
    第三个人是一个很瘦的年轻人，他叫朱龙，是李时的好朋友，也是这个屋子的常客。
除此之外，还有一个年轻的侍女。她不是很高，有点胖。她是主妇文华最信任的人，名字叫做小凤。
    一个小时前，李时夫妇和朱龙在电影院看了一部鬼片。这是李时夫妇第一次看鬼片，他们一向胆小，特别是文华，怕鬼怕得厉害。但人都是这样，越是怕，越想看。因此，回到家后，他们还不满足于电影中的故事，开始聊起自己听过的鬼故事。
    朱龙对鬼故事没什么兴趣，但是为了助兴，这晚他也讲了几个鬼故事。就连那侍女小凤，也兴奋地讲了一个鬼故事。
    她说：“在我们家那边，有一个很坏的律师。有一回，他为了钱，把一个好人害死了。事后三年，那个律师因为有了钱，生活得很好。谁知，三年后的一个晚上，他和朋友喝完酒后一个人走回家。在回家的路上，他一直觉得后面有人跟着他。那个时候已经很晚了，他走的又都是小路，所以路上没有人，也没有灯光，很黑、很安静。他很奇怪，为什么路上明明没有人，他却一直感觉到后面有脚步声？而且只要他一停下来，脚步声就听不见了。但只要他一开始走路，脚步声又响起来了。他借着月光，回头一看：呀！那个人不是别人，正是他三年前害死的那个好人。那个人静静地看着他，轻轻地笑着。那个律师吓得马上跑回了家。他只觉得后面的脚步声，静静地，一直跟着他，一直把他送到了家门口。回到家后，那个律师已经说不出话来了。当晚，他就得了急病死了。死后，他的家人发现他的脖子上有一个又黑又大的手印。后来，人们都说那是鬼的手印，他是被鬼手杀死的。”
    侍女小凤一口气把故事讲完了。最后不知道她是不是还想吓吓大家，她说：“这其实不是一个鬼故事，而是一件真事，因为那个律师的家就在我们家附近。”
    主妇文华听到这是真事，吓得抱住了自己的丈夫。等小凤讲完这个鬼故事，夜已深了。这个小洋楼在上海市郊区，本来就是一个特别安静的地方。而现在说话声一停，更显出了四周死一般的静。朱龙站起来，向李时夫妇说了再见后，回家了。小凤收拾了一下客厅，也回到了她在三楼的房间。
    李时夫妇回到房间后，李时已经困得不行，躺在床上马上就睡着了。文华却睡不着。这个胆小的女子，不仅晚上看了鬼片，还听了很多鬼故事。现在她听着窗外“呼呼”的风声，再看看这房间四周，总觉得有什么地方不对。最后小凤讲的那个“鬼手”的故事，不知为什么，一直在她的脑海里出现。
fullText.traditional:
這是一個十二月的夜晚，時間已經過了十二點。
    說話聲和笑聲時不時地從一個三層樓的小洋樓裡傳來。有四個人坐在小洋樓客廳的沙發上。雖然已經很晚了，但是他們完全沒有睡意，因為他們正在興奮地講著鬼故事。
    這四個人中，有兩人是這個屋子的主人和主婦。主人李時，年齡大概三十歲，是一個公子哥兒，因為家裡有錢，他每天只知道吃喝玩樂。主婦文華，不過二十四五歲，穿著漂亮的衣服，笑起來很美。
    第三個人是一個很瘦的年輕人，他叫朱龍，是李時的好朋友，也是這個屋子的常客。
除此之外，還有一個年輕的侍女。她不是很高，有點胖。她是主婦文華最信任的人，名字叫做小鳳。
    一個小時前，李時夫婦和朱龍在電影院看了一部鬼片。這是李時夫婦第一次看鬼片，他們一向膽小，特別是文華，怕鬼怕得厲害。但人都是這樣，越是怕，越想看。因此，回到家後，他們還不滿足於電影中的故事，開始聊起自己聽過的鬼故事。
    朱龍對鬼故事沒什麼興趣，但是為了助興，這晚他也講了幾個鬼故事。就連那侍女小鳳，也興奮地講了一個鬼故事。
    她說：“在我們家那邊，有一個很壞的律師。有一回，他為了錢，把一個好人害死了。事後三年，那個律師因為有了錢，生活得很好。誰知，三年後的一個晚上，他和朋友喝完酒後一個人走回家。在回家的路上，他一直覺得後面有人跟著他。那個時候已經很晚了，他走的又都是小路，所以路上沒有人，也沒有燈光，很黑、很安靜。他很奇怪，為什麼路上明明沒有人，他卻一直感覺到後面有腳步聲？而且只要他一停下來，腳步聲就聽不見了。但只要他一開始走路，腳步聲又響起來了。他借著月光，回頭一看：呀！那個人不是別人，正是他三年前害死的那個好人。那個人靜靜地看著他，輕輕地笑著。那個律師嚇得馬上跑回了家。他只覺得後面的腳步聲，靜靜地，一直跟著他，一直把他送到了家門口。回到家後，那個律師已經說不出話來了。當晚，他就得了急病死了。死後，他的家人發現他的脖子上有一個又黑又大的手印。後來，人們都說那是鬼的手印，他是被鬼手殺死的。”
    侍女小鳳一口氣把故事講完了。最後不知道她是不是還想嚇嚇大家，她說：“這其實不是一個鬼故事，而是一件真事，因為那個律師的家就在我們家附近。”
    主婦文華聽到這是真事，嚇得抱住了自己的丈夫。等小鳳講完這個鬼故事，夜已深了。這個小洋樓在上海市郊區，本來就是一個特別安靜的地方。而現在說話聲一停，更顯出了四周死一般的靜。朱龍站起來，向李時夫婦說了再見後，回家了。小鳳收拾了一下客廳，也回到了她在三樓的房間。
    李時夫婦回到房間後，李時已經睏得不行，躺在床上馬上就睡著了。文華卻睡不著。這個膽小的女子，不僅晚上看了鬼片，還聽了很多鬼故事。現在她聽著窗外“呼呼”的風聲，再看看這房間四周，總覺得有什麼地方不對。最後小鳳講的那個“鬼手”的故事，不知為什麼，一直在她的腦海裡出現。

sentences.english: He took advantage of the moonlight and turned his head to look:

sentences.simplified: 呀！那个人不是别人，正是他三年前害死的那个好人。
sentences.traditional: 呀！那個人不是別人，正是他三年前害死的那個好人。
sentences.pinyin: ya nà ge rén bú shì bié ren zhèng shì tā sān nián qián hài sǐ de nà ge hǎo rén
sentences.english: Oh! That person isn’t someone else, it’s exactly that good person that he killed three years ago.

sentences.simplified: 那个人静静地看着他，轻轻地笑着。
sentences.traditional: 那個人靜靜地看著他，輕輕地笑著。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén jìng jìng de kàn zhe tā qīng qīng de xiào zhe
sentences.english: That person calmly looked at him and smiled lightly.

sentences.simplified: 那个律师吓得马上跑回了家。
sentences.traditional: 那個律師嚇得馬上跑回了家。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge lǜ shī xià de mǎ shàng pǎo huí le jiā
sentences.english: That lawyer was so scared that he ran straight back home.

sentences.simplified: 他只觉得后面的脚步声，静静地，一直跟着他，
sentences.traditional: 他只覺得後面的腳步聲，靜靜地，一直跟著他，
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ jué de hòu miàn de jiǎo bù shēng jìng jìng de yì zhí gēn zhe tā
sentences.english: He only felt that the sound of footsteps behind him calmly following him all along, ..

sentences.simplified: 一直把他送到了家门口。
sentences.traditional: 一直把他送到了家門口。
sentences.pinyin: yì zhí bǎ tā sòng dào le jiā mén kǒu
sentences.english: .. seeing him off all the way to the door of his house.

sentences.simplified: 回到家后，那个律师已经说不出话来了。当晚，他就得了急病死了。
sentences.traditional: 回到家後，那個律師已經說不出話來了。當晚，他就得了急病死了。
sentences.pinyin: huí dào jiā hòu nà ge lǜ shī yǐ jīng shuō bù chū huà lái le dàng wǎn tā jiù dé le jí bìng sǐ le
sentences.english: After he got back home, that lawyer was utterly speechless. That night, he got seriously ill and died.

sentences.simplified: 死后，他的家人发现他的脖子上有一个又黑又大的手印。
sentences.traditional: 死後，他的家人發現他的脖子上有一個又黑又大的手印。
sentences.pinyin: sǐ hòu tā de jiā rén fā xiàn tā de bó zi shang yǒu yí ge yòu hēi yòu dà de shǒu yìn
sentences.english: After he died, his family discovered a both dark and big handprint on his neck.

sentences.simplified: 后来，人们都说那是鬼的手印，他是被鬼手杀死的。”
sentences.traditional: 後來，人們都說那是鬼的手印，他是被鬼手殺死的。”
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái rén men dōu shuō nà shì guǐ de shǒu yìn tā shì bèi guǐ shǒu shā sǐ de
sentences.english: Afterwards, everyone said that it was the ghost’s handprint, that he was killed by the ghost’s hand.”

sentences.simplified: 侍女小凤一口气把故事讲完了。
sentences.traditional: 侍女小鳳一口氣把故事講完了。
sentences.pinyin: shì nǚ xiǎo fèng yì kǒu qì bǎ gù shi jiǎng wán le
sentences.english: The maid Xiaofeng told the whole story in one go.

sentences.simplified: 最后不知道她是不是还想吓吓大家，她说：
sentences.traditional: 最後不知道她是不是還想嚇嚇大家，她說：
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu bù zhī dào tā shì bú shì hái xiǎng xià xià dà jiā tā shuō
sentences.english: In the end, perhaps in order to scare everyone, she said:

sentences.simplified: “这其实不是一个鬼故事，而是一件真事，因为那个律师的家就在我们家附近。”
sentences.traditional: “這其實不是一個鬼故事，而是一件真事，因為那個律師的家就在我們家附近。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè qí shí bú shì yí ge guǐ gù shi ér shì yí jiàn zhēn shì yīn wèi nà ge lǜ shī de jiā jiù zài wǒ men jiā fù jìn
sentences.english: “This isn’t actually a ghost story, but something that really happened, because that lawyer’s house was near our house.”

sentences.simplified: 主妇文华听到这是真事，吓得抱住了自己的丈夫。
sentences.traditional: 主婦文華聽到這是真事，嚇得抱住了自己的丈夫。
sentences.pinyin: zhǔ fù wén huá tīng dào zhè shì zhēn shì xià de bào zhù le zì jǐ de zhàng fu
sentences.english: The housewife Wen Hua was so scared from hearing this story that she firmly held her husband.

sentences.simplified: 等小凤讲完这个鬼故事，夜已深了。
sentences.traditional: 等小鳳講完這個鬼故事，夜已深了。
sentences.pinyin: děng xiǎo fèng jiǎng wán zhè ge guǐ gù shi yè yǐ shēn le
sentences.english: By the time Xiaofeng finished telling this ghost story, the night had already deepened.

sentences.simplified: 这个小洋楼在上海市郊区，本来就是一个特别安静的地方。
sentences.traditional: 這個小洋樓在上海市郊區，本來就是一個特別安靜的地方。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge xiǎo yáng lóu zài shàng hǎi shì jiāo qū běn lái jiù shì yí ge tè bié ān jìng de dì fang
sentences.english: This small Western-styled house was in the suburbs of Shanghai City, already an unusually calm place.

sentences.simplified: 而现在说话声一停，更显出了四周死一般的静。
sentences.traditional: 而現在說話聲一停，更顯出了四周死一般的靜。
sentences.pinyin: ér xiàn zài shuō huà shēng yì tíng gèng xiǎn chū le sì zhōu sǐ yì bān de jìng
sentences.english: But now as soon as the sound of voices stopped, the generally dead quietness all around them was even more pronounced.

sentences.simplified: 朱龙站起来，向李时夫妇说了再见后，回家了。
sentences.traditional: 朱龍站起來，向李時夫婦說了再見後，回家了。
sentences.pinyin: zhū lóng zhàn qǐ lai xiàng lǐ shí fū fù shuō le zài jiàn hòu huí jiā le
sentences.english: Zhu Long stood up, and after saying goodbye to the Li Shi couple, he returned home.

sentences.simplified: 小凤收拾了一下客厅，也回到了她在三楼的房间。
sentences.traditional: 小鳳收拾了一下客廳，也回到了她在三樓的房間。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo fèng shōu shi le yí xià kè tīng yě huí dào le tā zài sān lóu de fáng jiān
sentences.english: Xiaofeng tidied up the living room a bit, and also returned to her room on the third floor.

sentences.simplified: 李时夫妇回到房间后，
sentences.traditional: 李時夫婦回到房間後，
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí fū fù huí dào fáng jiān hòu
sentences.english: After the Li Shi couple came back to the room, ..

sentences.simplified: 李时已经困得不行，躺在床上马上就睡着了。
sentences.traditional: 李時已經睏得不行，躺在床上馬上就睡著了。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí yǐ jīng kùn de bù xíng tǎng zài chuáng shang mǎ shàng jiù shuì zháo le
sentences.english: .. Li Shi was already too tired to function, laid down on the bed and fell asleep immediately.

sentences.simplified: 文华却睡不着。
sentences.traditional: 文華卻睡不著。
sentences.pinyin: wén huá què shuì bù zháo
sentences.english: Yet Wen Hua couldn’t sleep.

sentences.simplified: 这个胆小的女子，不仅晚上看了鬼片，还听了很多鬼故事。
sentences.traditional: 這個膽小的女子，不僅晚上看了鬼片，還聽了很多鬼故事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge dǎn xiǎo de nǚ zǐ bù jǐn wǎn shang kàn le guǐ piàn hái tīng le hěn duō guǐ gù shi
sentences.english: This cowardly woman, had not only seen a ghost movie in the evening but also heard a lot of ghost stories.

sentences.simplified: 现在她听着窗外“呼呼”的风声，
sentences.traditional: 現在她聽著窗外“呼呼”的風聲，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā tīng zhe chuāng wài hū hū de fēng shēng
sentences.english: Now she heard the wind swooshing outside the window, ..

sentences.simplified: 再看看这房间四周，总觉得有什么地方不对。
sentences.traditional: 再看看這房間四周，總覺得有什麼地方不對。
sentences.pinyin: zài kàn kan zhè fáng jiān sì zhōu zǒng jué de yǒu shén me dì fang bú duì
sentences.english: .. looked all around the room again, and thought all the time that something wasn’t right.

sentences.simplified: 最后小凤讲的那个“鬼手”的故事，
sentences.traditional: 最後小鳳講的那個“鬼手”的故事，
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu xiǎo fèng jiǎng de nà ge guǐ shǒu de gù shi
sentences.english: That story about a “ghost hand” that Xiaofeng had told in the end, ..

sentences.simplified: 不知为什么，一直在她的脑海里出现。
sentences.traditional: 不知為什麼，一直在她的腦海裡出現。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī wèi shén me yì zhí zài tā de nǎo hǎi lǐ chū xiàn
sentences.english: .. without her knowing why, kept appearing in her mind.

sentence_translations: It’s a December night, and the time has already passed 12 o’clock.
From time to time, the sound of talking and laughing comes through from inside a small three-story Western-style house.
There are four people sitting on the sofa in the living room of the small Western-style house.
Although it’s already gotten very late, they’re not sleepy at all, because they’re currently excitedly telling ghost stories.
Among these four people, there are two people that are the owner and the housewife of this house.
The owner Li Shi, aged roughly about 30 years old, is a pampered son of a wealthy family.
Because there is wealth in the family, he only knows to eat, drink and be merry every day.
The housewife Wen Hua, no more than 24-25 years old, is wearing beautiful clothes and smiling very beautifully.
The third person is a very thin young person, he is called Zhu Long.
He is Li Shi’s good friend, and also a frequent visitor to this house.
Apart from this, there is also a young maid. She’s not very tall, and a little overweight.
She’s the person that the housewife Wen Hua trusts the most. Her name is Xiaofeng.
An hour before, the Li Shi couple and Zhu Long watched a ghost movie at the movie theater.
This was the first time that the Li Shi couple had seen a ghost movie.
They’ve always been cowardly, especially Wen Hua, she’s seriously afraid of ghosts.
But all people are like this, the more afraid they are, the more they want to see it.
Consequently, after they returned home, they were still not satisfied with the story in the movie.
They started telling ghost stories they had heard themselves.
Zhu Long didn’t have any interest in ghost stories, but in order to add to the fun, ..
.. he also told a few ghost stories this night.
Even that maid Xiaofeng also excitedly told a ghost story.
She said: “Over by our house, there was a very bad lawyer. One time, he killed a good person for money.”
Three years after the event, that lawyer lived very well because he had money.
Who would have thought, an evening three years later, ..
.. when he was walking home alone after he finished drinking alcohol with friends.
On the way back home, he felt all along that someone was following behind him.
It was already very late at that time, and all the roads he was walking on were small.
So there was no one on the road, no lights either, it was very dark, and very quiet.
He felt very strange, how was it that there was obviously no one on the road, ..
.. yet he felt all along that there was the sound of footsteps behind him?
And also as soon as he stopped, the sound of footsteps disappeared.
But as soon as he started walking, the sounding of footsteps started again.
He took advantage of the moonlight and turned his head to look:
Oh! That person isn’t someone else, it’s exactly that good person that he killed three years ago.
That person calmly looked at him and smiled lightly.
That lawyer was so scared that he ran straight back home.
He only felt that the sound of footsteps behind him calmly following him all along, ..
.. seeing him off all the way to the door of his house.
After he got back home, that lawyer was utterly speechless. That night, he got seriously ill and died.
After he died, his family discovered a both dark and big handprint on his neck.
Afterwards, everyone said that it was the ghost’s handprint, that he was killed by the ghost’s hand.”
The maid Xiaofeng told the whole story in one go.
In the end, perhaps in order to scare everyone, she said:
“This isn’t actually a ghost story, but something that really happened, because that lawyer’s house was near our house.”
The housewife Wen Hua was so scared from hearing this story that she firmly held her husband.
By the time Xiaofeng finished telling this ghost story, the night had already deepened.
This small Western-styled house was in the suburbs of Shanghai City, already an unusually calm place.
But now as soon as the sound of voices stopped, the generally dead quietness all around them was even more pronounced.
Zhu Long stood up, and after saying goodbye to the Li Shi couple, he returned home.
Xiaofeng tidied up the living room a bit, and also returned to her room on the third floor.
After the Li Shi couple came back to the room, ..
.. Li Shi was already too tired to function, laid down on the bed and fell asleep immediately.
Yet Wen Hua couldn’t sleep.
This cowardly woman, had not only seen a ghost movie in the evening but also heard a lot of ghost stories.
Now she heard the wind swooshing outside the window, ..
.. looked all around the room again, and thought all the time that something wasn’t right.
That story about a “ghost hand” that Xiaofeng had told in the end, ..
.. without her knowing why, kept appearing in her mind.
